definitions.commit: first second with >= 2 living T players on the site core (BombsiteA/B callout), or the plant
definitions.attempt: target, or for no_hit rounds the lane of the densest execute utility (>= 3 grenades in 10 s)
definitions.split: entry points onto the site >= 400 units apart, or bearings from the site centre >= 50 degrees apart
definitions.lurk: a living T on the other site's lane or >= 2200 units from the target, at the commit or 10 s before
definitions.fake: >= 2 smokes/molotovs or >= 3 grenades landing near the other site 30-5 s before the commit
definitions.recipe: gun rounds hitting one site with similar smoke+molotov spot sets (average linkage, Jaccard <= 0.6); core = spots in >= 50% of its rounds, options = 20-50%
definitions.ct_setup: lanes of living CT players at 20 s
definitions.forward: CT standing at 15 s on a callout the T side holds in >= 60% of samples
definitions.stack: a site lane with >= max(3, map median + 2) CT players at 20 s
definitions.rotation: CT players on the other site's lane 5 s before the commit who reach the target lane within 20 s
